tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Locate likely files under the session workspace root.

input_schema.title: SearchFilesArgs
input_schema.description: Arguments for the `search_files` tool: a bounded lexical/filename search over the workspace root.

query.description: Query terms used to rank candidate file paths. An empty query returns a well-formed empty result set.

max_matches.description: Maximum number of ranked matches to return.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a relative file, or a bounded line range within it, under the session workspace root.

input_schema.title: ReadArgs
input_schema.description:
Arguments for the `read` tool.

Reads the full contents of a file, or an optional 1-indexed line range, under the workspace root. Any field not listed here (including a legacy `max_bytes`) is rejected as a malformed argument rather than silently ignored.

path.description: Path to read, relative to the workspace root.

offset.description: Optional 1-indexed first line to return. Omit to read from the start of the file. Zero is rejected as a malformed argument, not clamped to line 1.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of lines to return, starting at `offset` (or the first line if `offset` is omitted). Omit to read to the end of the file. Zero is rejected as a malformed argument, not clamped.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Bounded file listing under the session workspace root.

input_schema.title: FindArgs
input_schema.description: Arguments for the `find` tool: bounded filename discovery under the workspace root.

glob.description: Glob pattern to match relative to the workspace root.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Bounded text search under the session workspace root.

input_schema.title: GrepArgs
input_schema.description: Arguments for the `grep` tool: bounded regex line search under the workspace root.

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List the direct children of a relative directory under the session workspace root.

input_schema.title: ListDirArgs
input_schema.description:
Arguments for the `list_dir` tool.

Lists the direct children of one relative directory under the workspace root. Any field not listed here is rejected as a malformed argument rather than silently ignored.

path.description: Directory to list, relative to the workspace root. Omit (or pass an empty string) to list the workspace root itself.

tools.name: ast_grep
tools.description: Bounded ast-grep structural search over a single caller-declared language, scoped to the session workspace root.

AstGrepLanguage.description: The seven languages this lease supports. No aliases: a caller must spell the canonical name exactly (e.g. `"typescript"`, not `"ts"`).

input_schema.description: Arguments for the `ast_grep` tool: bounded ast-grep-pattern structural search scoped to a single caller-declared language per call.

context.description: Number of source lines of context to include on each side of a match (0 to 5). Defaults to 0.

glob.description: Optional glob restricting a directory scan's candidate files.

lang.description: The single language every `pat` (and `sel`, if present) is compiled and every scanned file is parsed against.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (1 to 1000). Defaults to 100.

offset.description: Number of leading matches (in the deterministic order) to skip before `limit` is applied. At most 100000. Defaults to 0.

pat.description: 1 to 8 ast-grep pattern strings (or, with `sel` present, node-kind selectors), each at most 4096 bytes.

path.description: Workspace-relative file or directory to scan. Defaults to `.`.

sel.description: Optional contextual-pattern parse context. When present, each `pat[i]` is a node-kind selector extracted from this context rather than an ordinary ast-grep pattern.

input_schema.title: AstGrepArgs

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Apply byte-range replacements to a relative file under the session workspace root, guarded by an expected SHA-256 precondition.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create or replace a relative file under the session workspace root, guarded by an expected SHA-256 precondition.

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Execute a single allowlisted local process, without a shell, under the session workspace root.

input_schema.description: Provider-facing arguments. Unknown keys, including shell-source and stdin keys, are refused by serde before a process can be spawned.
input_schema.title: BashArgs
